Definition: , including the feminine οὖσα; and the neuter ὄν present participle of G1510; being:--be, come, have.
BiblicalUsage: On is the present participle of to be, being, the one who is. Joseph, being a just man, will not expose Mary in Matthew 1:19, and John 3:31 says he that is of the earth is earthly, while he that comes from heaven is above all. Revelation 1:8 lifts the word to the Lord Himself: which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe being is the smallest word with the largest claim, because the One who is was before all things and will be after them.
RelatedEvents: John's Vision of the Risen Christ on Patmos
